description.value:
From Spice Girl · Price: touch only; softened things become rubber, and that can include your footing.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 1 action: your stand softens an object it touches; it's rubbery, Hardness 0, and bounces. Or it softens the armor or hide of a creature it touches (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates): it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 round, or for 1 minute on a critical failure. Once per turn your stand can soften the creature it hits as part of a Strike (1 action).
  • 5: Softened ground: creatures falling onto it take no damage, and a creature knocked onto it bounces 10 ft. 1 action: soften the ground under a creature your stand touches: it sinks and snaps back up, taking @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}), and falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone} on a failure. Surge: soften a creature's weapon or armor: weapon damage is halved, or AC –2 for 1 minute (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).
  • 9: Your surge can soften both a creature's weapon and its armor at once.
  • 13: Soften a 20-ft area of wall or floor: difficult terrain, and you can push through it like water. A creature that fails against your softened armor or hide is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 minute.
  • 17: Soften a creature's body (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude}): @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 2} and it can squeeze, but it also can't hold anything for 1 round.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.FWzQbZUMhOQxSUq9]{Effect: Softened Armor}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
